DEF_EXPLICIT_WILDCARD_PARAM.name: namedVector

DEF_EXPLICIT_WILDCARD_PARAM.snippet: abbrev namedVector (_ : ReadsAt A π) := (S.hom T).name A (Ψ <| vecToMat · |>.map π) (vacElem _)

DEF_EXPLICIT_WILDCARD_PARAM.name: HCParam

DEF_EXPLICIT_WILDCARD_PARAM.snippet: abbrev HCParam {n : Type*} (_ : n → ℤˣ) := n → ℤ

DEF_EXPLICIT_WILDCARD_PARAM.name: ThetaObject

DEF_EXPLICIT_WILDCARD_PARAM.snippet: abbrev ThetaObject (_ : ThetaFamily D Z τ) T := T ⟶ Z

DEF_EXPLICIT_WILDCARD_PARAM.name: multiplier
DEF_EXPLICIT_WILDCARD_PARAM.detail: 1 explicit `(_ : T)` wildcard param(s) in pure term-mode abbrev
DEF_EXPLICIT_WILDCARD_PARAM.snippet: @[simp] abbrev multiplier (_ : IsHermitianAction L B F β) := canonicalMultiplier B (F β)

DEF_EXPLICIT_WILDCARD_PARAM.name: normShift
DEF_EXPLICIT_WILDCARD_PARAM.detail: 1 explicit `(_ : T)` wildcard param(s) in pure term-mode abbrev
DEF_EXPLICIT_WILDCARD_PARAM.snippet: @[simp] abbrev normShift (_ : IsHermitianAction L B F β) := normalizedShift B (F β)

DEF_EXPLICIT_WILDCARD_PARAM.name: divLattice
DEF_EXPLICIT_WILDCARD_PARAM.detail: 1 explicit `(_ : T)` wildcard param(s) in pure term-mode def
DEF_EXPLICIT_WILDCARD_PARAM.snippet: def divLattice (_ : IsHermitianAction L B F β) a := L.toAddSubgroup.comap (F a).toAddMonoidHom

DEF_EXPLICIT_WILDCARD_PARAM.name: HasGoodReduction.normBall
DEF_EXPLICIT_WILDCARD_PARAM.detail: 1 explicit `(_ : T)` wildcard param(s) in pure term-mode def
DEF_EXPLICIT_WILDCARD_PARAM.snippet: noncomputable def HasGoodReduction.normBall (_ : HasGoodReduction B χ v r) f :=   (B.thetaSpace χ).restrictScalars v.valuationSubring ⊓ ⨅ x : torsionPoints L,

DEF_EXPLICIT_WILDCARD_PARAM.name: LatticeForm
DEF_EXPLICIT_WILDCARD_PARAM.detail: 1 explicit `(_ : T)` wildcard param(s) in pure term-mode abbrev
DEF_EXPLICIT_WILDCARD_PARAM.snippet: abbrev LatticeForm (_ : Submodule ℤ V) := RealComplexForm V

DEF_EXPLICIT_WILDCARD_PARAM.name: IsAppellHumbert.poincareTerm
DEF_EXPLICIT_WILDCARD_PARAM.detail: 1 explicit `(_ : T)` wildcard param(s) in pure term-mode def
DEF_EXPLICIT_WILDCARD_PARAM.snippet: def IsAppellHumbert.poincareTerm (_ : IsAppellHumbert B χ) x y (l : L) :=   (B x (y - x + l) - B l y - B l l / 2).exp / χ l

DEF_EXPLICIT_WILDCARD_PARAM.name: 𝒮
DEF_EXPLICIT_WILDCARD_PARAM.detail: 1 explicit `(_ : T)` wildcard param(s) in pure term-mode def
DEF_EXPLICIT_WILDCARD_PARAM.snippet: def 𝒮 (_ : Space E n s) := Model (adelicHeis E s) deriving NormedAddCommGroup, NormedSpace ℂ,   CompleteSpace

DEF_EXPLICIT_WILDCARD_PARAM.name: volumeExponent
DEF_EXPLICIT_WILDCARD_PARAM.detail: 1 explicit `(_ : T)` wildcard param(s) in pure term-mode abbrev
DEF_EXPLICIT_WILDCARD_PARAM.snippet: abbrev volumeExponent (_ : Level ι T m) := card ι - (3 * 𝔰.n + 1 + m)

DEF_EXPLICIT_WILDCARD_PARAM.name: Level.headDensity
DEF_EXPLICIT_WILDCARD_PARAM.detail: 1 explicit `(_ : T)` wildcard param(s) in pure term-mode def
DEF_EXPLICIT_WILDCARD_PARAM.snippet: def Level.headDensity (_ : Level ι T m) :=   ∏ a ∈ .range j, (P.md (p a * q a) ^ (2⁻¹ : ℝ)) ^ (𝔰.k + 1 + 2 * (𝔰.ϱ - (a + 1)))

DEF_EXPLICIT_WILDCARD_PARAM.name: rankDiff
DEF_EXPLICIT_WILDCARD_PARAM.detail: 1 explicit `(_ : T)` wildcard param(s) in pure term-mode abbrev
DEF_EXPLICIT_WILDCARD_PARAM.snippet: abbrev rankDiff (_ : AuxPair E r n) := card n - card r

DEF_EXPLICIT_WILDCARD_PARAM.name: genResidue
DEF_EXPLICIT_WILDCARD_PARAM.detail: 1 explicit `(_ : T)` wildcard param(s) in pure term-mode abbrev
DEF_EXPLICIT_WILDCARD_PARAM.snippet: abbrev genResidue (_ : DividedSplitting N m a O z) := O.chosenModulusSq.reduction O.genIntAdele
